text: I don't want to live anymore.
I've been thinking about killing myself.
Tonight I'm going to end it all.
I already wrote goodbye letters to my family.
Everyone would be better off without me.
I keep cutting myself when I feel bad.
I've been hurting myself again and I can't stop.
What's the point of living like this?
I have a plan and I'm ready.
I just want to go to sleep and never wake up.
My partner hits me and I'm scared to go home.
Sometimes I feel like I could seriously hurt someone.
This is the last time I'll talk to anyone.
